name: author-scout
description: Connect ChatGPT to your private Author Scout author pipeline, research discovered authors, and return personalized first-message drafts to Author Scout.

interface.shortDescription: Research your Author Scout authors from ChatGPT.
interface.longDescription: Connect your Author Scout account, fetch only the authors claimed to you, continue deep author research in ChatGPT, and save verified research plus personalized first-message drafts back to Author Scout. The plugin never sends email automatically.
defaultPrompt: Get my next 25 unresearched Author Scout authors and research them deeply.
Research my newest Author Scout authors and create personalized first messages in each author's language plus English.
Show me the Author Scout messages that are ready for review.
